stories.title: Live: At least 160 dead and 400 tourists missing in Nepal landslide
stories.summary: A landslide unleashed a torrent of mud and water across Nepal on Wednesday, killing at least 157 people and leaving more than 400 tourists missing near the border with China. The disaster swept away homes, roads and bridges, while officials warned the death toll could rise as rescue teams searched for survivors. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

stories.title: Russia’s pivot to East became only option since special military operation — Kobyakov
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 27. Russia’s pivot to the East became the only viable option after the start of the special military operation due to sanctions and the severing of ties with the West, Russian Presidential Adviser and Executive Secretary of the Eastern Economic Forum (EEF) Organizing Committee Anton Kobyakov told TASS in an interview ahead of the forum. "With the start of the special military operation, the ‘pivot to the East’ became the only viable option due to sanctions and the severing of ties with the West. While at the beginning of 2022 Russian gas accounted for 41% of the European market, by the end of the year its share had officially fallen to 7.5%. On the other hand, virtually no Asian country, with the exception of Japan - and even then, in a much milder form than the West - condemned the special military operation or joined the anti-Russian front being formed on the basis of NATO," he said. "We see the EEF’s task as creating a balance in economic cooperation, primarily through engagement with ASEAN countries and a number of APEC economies," he stressed. "The southern dimension is locally linked to ASEAN. Its relevance is confirmed by trade statistics for Asia’s leading economic grouping and its key partners, among which Russia occupies a modest 14th place with trade totaling $22 bln. By comparison, China’s trade exceeds $980 bln - almost $1 trillion; the United States’ stands at around $490 bln; the EU’s at $235 bln; and India’s at $189 bln," Kobyakov explained. The Eastern Economic Forum will be held on September 1-4 in Vladivostok on the campus of Far Eastern Federal University. The forum is organized by the Roscongress Foundation with the support of the Russian government. TASS is the general information partner.

stories.title: LG Innotek to supply camera modules for Amazon's Zoox robotaxis
stories.summary: LG Innotek Co., an electronic components manufacturing unit of LG Group, said Thursday it will mass-produce and supply automotive camera modules for robotaxis operated by Amazon's autonomous driving subsidiary Zoox. This marks the first time. LG Innotek will ship camera modules specifically for robotaxis, LG Innotek said in a press release. Zoox, an autonomous driving technology company acquired by Amazon in 2020, established what it calls the world's first robotaxi production facility in California last year. It began offering paid robotaxi services to the general public in Las Vegas on Aug. 10. Zoox's robotaxis are designed to operate without driver intervention and feature four passenger seats arranged to face one another, without a steering wheel.
